item.title: França e Arábia Saudita farão parque temático de Dragon Ball Z perto de Paris por 6 bilhões de euros
item.description: França e Arábia Saudita concordaram em construir um parque de diversões com temática de mangá no valor de 6 bilhões de euros (7 bilhões de dólares) perto de Paris, informou o Palácio do Eliseu nesta segunda-feira, durante uma visita do príncipe herdeiro saudita Mohammed bin Salman à capital francesa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: França e Arábia Saudita concordaram em construir um parque de diversões com temática de mangá no valor de 6 bilhões de euros (7 bilhões de dólares) perto de Paris, informou o Palácio do Eliseu nesta segunda-feira, durante uma visita do príncipe herdeiro saudita Mohammed bin Salman à capital francesa. O projeto, inspirado no universo da famosa franquia japonesa de mangá e anime Dragon Ball Z, será construído perto de Cergy-Pontoise, a noroeste de Paris, e deve gerar cerca de 22 mil empregos, segundo o Palácio do Eliseu. A ideia surgiu depois que o presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, e o príncipe herdeiro saudita descobriram que compartilhavam o mesmo entusiasmo por Dragon Ball Z durante a visita de Macron à Arábia Saudita em 2025, informaram assessores de Macron. O grupo saudita de entretenimento e investimentos Qiddiya financiará o projeto, que faz parte dos esforços do reino para diversificar sua economia para além do petróleo e expandir sua presença global no setor de lazer. Ainda não foi definida uma data de inauguração para o que seria um dos maiores parques temáticos da Europa, e a construção deve levar vários anos. Bin Salman, que possui um castelo perto de Paris, está realizando uma rara viagem oficial ao exterior e apareceu ao lado de Macron na cerimônia de encerramento da Copa do Mundo de Esports, em Paris, no domingo. Autoridades francesas apresentaram o projeto Dragon Ball Z como prova de que a França continua sendo um polo de atração para investimentos estrangeiros, embora detalhes-chave para o amplo empreendimento — que incluiria três parques temáticos diferentes — ainda estejam por definir.

item.title: Furacão Lala aciona pagamento de seguro de recifes de coral no Havaí
item.description: Uma apólice de seguro paramétrica elaborada pela Willis, que cobre os recifes de coral ao redor do Havaí, foi acionada pelo furacão Lala, informou a segurada, a The Nature Conservancy (TNC).
item.dc:creator: Henry Gale
item.content:encoded: Uma apólice de seguro paramétrica elaborada pela Willis, que cobre os recifes de coral ao redor do Havaí, foi acionada pelo furacão Lala, informou a segurada, a The Nature Conservancy (TNC). Trata-se do primeiro pagamento desde que a apólice foi contratada, informou a ONG ambiental em uma postagem de blog na quinta-feira. A TNC não divulgou o valor, mas afirmou que o pagamento mínimo é de US$200.000. A Willis anunciou o lançamento da apólice em 2022, descrevendo-a como a primeira apólice de seguro para recifes de coral nos EUA. O furacão Lala, a primeira tempestade nomeada da temporada de furacões do Pacífico Central, trouxe ventos fortes e inundações para a ilha do Havaí ao passar ao sul do território no início deste mês. O desembolso do valor do seguro será determinado em colaboração com a Rede de Restauração de Emergência dos Recifes do Havaí (Herr, na sigla em inglês), um grupo composto por órgãos governamentais, cientistas, organizações sem fins lucrativos e grupos comunitários, informou a TNC. Os recursos serão utilizados para avaliar os recifes e determinar as próximas etapas para resgatar, recolocar e reparar quaisquer corais danificados, acrescentou a organização. Julia Rose, gerente do programa de restauração de corais da TNC no Havaí e em Palmyra, afirmou que os "recifes enfrentam muitas ameaças que estão além da nossa capacidade de lidar localmente, mas os danos físicos causados por tempestades são um impacto sobre o qual podemos agir". "Ao agirmos rapidamente para avaliar e reparar os recifes danificados, podemos dar aos corais uma chance maior de se recuperarem e continuarem a sustentar as comunidades do Havaí." Tanto a TNC quanto a Fundação Howden forneceram apoio que possibilitou a contratação da apólice, informou a TNC. Jody Yee, chefe de soluções alternativas de transferência de risco no âmbito das Américas na Willis, disse que o pagamento demonstra o valor de soluções inovadoras de risco. “Ao fornecer financiamento rápido imediatamente após um evento desencadeador, o programa ajuda a proteger ecossistemas críticos de recifes de corais e apoia uma recuperação mais rápida para as comunidades que dependem deles”, disse ele. “Este é o seguro paramétrico funcionando exatamente como pretendido: financiamento rápido e transparente quando é mais necessário, possibilitando a ação, em vez da espera. É um exemplo poderoso de como a transferência de risco pode apoiar tanto a resiliência ambiental quanto a sustentabilidade de longo prazo.”

item.title: Dangote refinery drives seven-fold rise in Nigeria petroleum product exports, EIA says
item.description: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, as output from the Dangote refinery improved regional fuel trade flows and boosted supplies to Europe and Africa, the U.S. Energy Information Administration said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, as output from the Dangote refinery improved regional fuel trade flows and boosted supplies to Europe and Africa, the U.S. Energy Information Administration said on Monday. Here are more details: Seaborne petroleum product shipments from Nigeria averaged 561,000 barrels per day in the second quarter of 2026, compared with an annual average of 79,000 bpd in 2023, Vortexa data showed. Of those shipments 350,000 bpd were exported during that period, compared with an annual average of 46,000 bpd in 2023. Dangote Group's Dangote Petroleum Refinery, located in the Lekki Free Zone near Lagos, began operations in 2024 and is the country's largest refinery. With the increased supply of petroleum products in Nigeria from the country's largest refinery, imports fell, exports increased, and Nigeria became more self-sufficient in refined petroleum products, EIA said. Product shipments expanded after operations at Dangote began and again following the completion of maintenance and expansion in February 2026, coinciding with supply constraints out of the Strait of Hormuz, EIA added. The maintenance increased the facility's crude oil distillation capacity from 650,000 bpd to 700,000 bpd. Intra-Nigerian shipments rose to 211,000 bpd in the second quarter of 2026, up from 81,000 bpd in 2025 and 33,000 bpd in 2023. Nigeria's seaborne petroleum product exports to Europe rose to 130,000 bpd in the second quarter of 2026 from 40,000 bpd in 2025 and 15,000 bpd in 2023, while exports to Africa climbed to nearly 120,000 bpd from 89,000 bpd a year earlier. Nigeria imported nearly 400,000 bpd of petroleum products in 2023, and seaborne imports fell to less than 130,000 bpd in the second quarter of 2026.

item.title: 米、対イラン二次制裁を拡大 財務長官「経済的生命線断つ」
item.description: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米トランプ政権は２４日、新たな対イラン制裁を発表し、イランとのビジネス関係を維持する国や団体に対する二次制裁の対象を拡大した。イランとの戦争が約６カ月に及ぶ中、イランへの経済的圧力を強化する考えだ。

ベセント財務長官は記者会見で、イランに対する「経済版Ｄデー」と呼ぶ措置について説明。「われわれは世界中のイランの金融ネットワークに対し、経済的な総攻撃を開始する」と表明し、「イラン政権を支えるあらゆる経済的生命線を断ち切ることが目的だ」と述べた。

さらに、米財務省はイランが石油の密輸や制裁回避に利用しているネットワークや仲介者、資金ルートを特定しており、米政府はパートナー国と協力し、イランの「違法な収入源」を全て標的にすると言明した。

米財務省の声明によると、核、ミサイル、サイバー攻撃、石油取引などに絡み、約６０の団体、個人、船舶が制裁対象に指定された。さらに、イラン政府が経済を支えるために利用しているデジタル資産、テクノロジー、金、航空、海運の５分野が新たに二次制裁の対象に追加された。

ベセント長官は「イランを支援するすべての国は、米国の制裁措置に直面する覚悟をしておくべきだ」と警告した。

item.title: US removes Syria from terrorism sponsor list, lifting major investment obstacle
item.description: The United States removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism on Monday, lifting what Damascus says was the last major impediment to investing in the country as Washington deepens ties to the new Syrian government.
item.dc:creator: Feras Dalatey
item.content:encoded: The United States removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism on Monday, lifting what Damascus says was the last major impediment to investing in the country as Washington deepens ties to the new Syrian government. The removal, posted on the U.S. Treasury's website, took effect after a 45-day congressional review period triggered when Trump formally notified Congress on July 8 of his intention to rescind the designation. “These actions were all taken in recognition of the positive actions taken and further commitments by the Syrian government under President Ahmed al-Sharaa to fully distance Syria from acts of international terrorism,” U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in a statement. Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shibani [USN:L8N44J06U TEXT:"told Reuters"] on Saturday that the government hoped removing what he called the "last obstacle" would help reconnect Syria to the global financial and economic system and boost investment. "There is no longer any obstacle to investment, doing business and rebuilding economic life in Syria," he said. Syria had been on the list since 1979, when Washington accused the government of former President Hafez al-Assad of supporting militant groups. The designation remained throughout the rule of his son Bashar al-Assad, who was toppled by rebels led by current President Ahmed al-Sharaa in December 2024. CUBA, IRAN, NORTH KOREA REMAIN Monday's announcement also removed the designation of the Nusrah Front as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist organization, leaving Cuba, Iran and North Korea as the three countries designated by Washington as state sponsors of terrorism. The designation carries restrictions on U.S. foreign assistance, defense exports and sales, certain dual-use items and financial transactions, and had remained a major deterrent for banks and investors even after Washington dismantled its broader sanctions program on Syria. Trump's administration terminated comprehensive U.S. sanctions on Syria in July 2025, while maintaining targeted sanctions against Assad and his associates, rights abusers, drug traffickers, Islamic State and al Qaeda affiliates and Iranian proxies. The U.S. Treasury has since said American financial institutions can provide services to Syria, process payments involving Syrian banks and establish correspondent banking relationships with them, provided sanctioned parties are not involved. But the terrorism designation remained a source of legal and compliance risk for firms considering entering Syria, whose government is seeking billions of dollars in investment to rebuild after nearly 14 years of war. Signs of interest had grown ahead of the removal. Syria's finance ministry said this month that Finance Minister Mohammad Yisr Barnieh held talks with Bank of America (BAC.N) executives over potential cooperation and Syria's reintegration into the international financial system. Bank officials expressed willingness to visit Syria and continue discussions, according to the ministry. Mastercard (MA.N) has gone further, announcing in May that it was working with QNB Group (QNBK.QA) and Syria's central bank to prepare infrastructure for international card payments in the country. The company has described itself as an early investor in Syria and said it wants to help connect Syrian consumers and businesses to global payment networks. CONTINUED COOPERATION Trump notified Congress of his decision after meeting Sharaa in Ankara in July, telling the Syrian president in a letter seen by Reuters that he [USN:S0N3Y802F TEXT:"had promised"] to "remove all barriers" preventing Syria from rebuilding. The delisting also followed months of negotiations between Damascus and Washington over Syria's economic and foreign policy. Reuters [USN:L6N43U0ZX TEXT:"reported"] this month that Damascus agreed to drastically reduce imports of Russian oil during discussions with Washington over lifting the terrorism designation, according to three sources familiar with the talks. Trump has increasingly embraced Sharaa, the former commander of al Qaeda's Nusra Front who broke ties with the global jihadist network in 2016 and led the rebel coalition that overthrew Assad. Washington has praised cooperation by Sharaa's government against Islamic State and said easing restrictions is intended to give Syria an opportunity to stabilise, attract investment and rebuild.

item.title: Francia y Arabia Saudita acuerdan proyecto de parque temático de "Dragon Ball Z" cerca de París
item.description: Francia y Arabia Saudita acordaron construir un parque de atracciones inspirado en el manga "Dragon Ball Z", con un costo de 6.000 millones de euros (7.000 millones de dólares), cerca de París, informó el Palacio del Elíseo el lunes durante la visita del príncipe heredero saudita Mohammed bin Salman a la capital francesa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Francia y Arabia Saudita acordaron construir un parque de atracciones inspirado en el manga "Dragon Ball Z", con un costo de 6.000 millones de euros (7.000 millones de dólares), cerca de París, informó el Palacio del Elíseo el lunes durante la visita del príncipe heredero saudita Mohammed bin Salman a la capital francesa. El proyecto, inspirado en el mundo de la exitosa franquicia japonesa de manga y anime, se construirá cerca de Cergy-Pontoise, al noroeste de la capital francesa, y se espera que genere unos 22.000 puestos de trabajo, según el Elíseo. La idea surgió después de que el presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron, y el príncipe heredero saudí descubrieran que compartían la misma pasión por Dragon Ball Z durante la visita de Macron a Arabia Saudita en 2025, según explicaron los asesores del mandatario francés. El grupo saudita de entretenimiento e inversión Qiddiya financiará el proyecto, que forma parte de la apuesta del reino por diversificar su economía más allá del petróleo y ampliar su presencia global en el sector del ocio. Aún no se ha fijado una fecha de inauguración para lo que sería uno de los complejos de parques temáticos más grandes de Europa, y se prevé que la construcción dure varios años. Bin Salman, propietario de un castillo cerca de París, está realizando un inusual viaje oficial al extranjero y apareció junto a Macron en la ceremonia de clausura de la Copa del Mundo de Esports celebrada el domingo en París. Las autoridades francesas presentan el proyecto de Dragon Ball Z como prueba de que Francia sigue siendo un imán para la inversión extranjera, aunque aún quedan por concretar detalles clave de este ambicioso complejo, que incluiría tres parques temáticos diferentes. (1 dólar = 0,8571 euros)

item.title: Plaintiffs lawyers' fee slashed in Google privacy settlement
item.description: A U.S. federal judge in San Jose has awarded Bartlit Beck and other plaintiffs’ firms a reduced legal fee of about $29 million for their work on a settlement resolving a lawsuit that accused Google of programming its Android operating system to collect the cellular data of smartphone users without their permission.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas, Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded:
A U.S. federal judge in San Jose has awarded Bartlit Beck and other plaintiffs’ firms a reduced legal fee of about $29 million for their work on a [USN:L6N3YT0WU TEXT:"settlement"] resolving a lawsuit that accused Google of programming its Android operating system to collect the cellular data of smartphone users without their permission. Here are the details: U.S. Magistrate Judge Virginia DeMarchi approved the settlement on Friday but said the requested fee of nearly $40 million would have overcompensated the plaintiffs' lawyers. The judge said the settlement's primary value was not money for class members but a requirement that Google provide disclosures about Android users' cellular data. Google in January agreed to pay $135 million to settle the proposed class action. As part of the settlement, the Alphabet unit (GOOGL.O) said it will not transfer data without obtaining consent from Android users when they set up their phones. “While the value of such transparency cannot be easily or accurately quantified, such relief is still significant in that it enables users to make informed decisions about whether to consent to the cellular data usage and continue using Android devices,” DeMarchi wrote in her order. The initial $39.8 million sought by lead plaintiffs' attorneys at Bartlit Beck and Korein Tillery amounted to about 29% of the settlement fund. Attorneys at those firms did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Google had opposed the requested legal fees. A spokesperson for the company did not immediately respond to a request for comment. DeMarch

i also granted final approval to the settlement on Friday.

item.title: EUA alertam países para que interrompam atividades com o Irã ou enfrentarão medidas
item.description: O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, apresentou nesta segunda-feira uma nova campanha de sanções norte-americanas contra o Irã, alertando que cada país tem um prazo definido para encerrar as atividades identificadas por Washington, sob pena de sofrer ações do Tesouro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, apresentou nesta segunda-feira uma nova campanha de sanções norte-americanas contra o Irã, alertando que cada país tem um prazo definido para encerrar as atividades identificadas por Washington, sob pena de sofrer ações do Tesouro. Bessent disse que o presidente Donald Trump estava fazendo ligações telefônicas para líderes mundiais com pedidos específicos para que cessem suas interações com o Irã. (Reportagem de David Lawder)

item.title: EEUU advierte a países de que deben poner fin a las actividades de Irán o se enfrentarán a medidas
item.description: El secretario del Tesoro Scott Bessent dio a conocer el lunes una nueva campaña de sanciones de Estados Unidos contra Irán y advirtió que cada país dispone de un plazo concreto para poner fin a las actividades señaladas por Washington o, de lo contrario, se enfrentará a medidas por parte del Tesoro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El secretario del Tesoro Scott Bessent dio a conocer el lunes una nueva campaña de sanciones de Estados Unidos contra Irán y advirtió que cada país dispone de un plazo concreto para poner fin a las actividades señaladas por Washington o, de lo contrario, se enfrentará a medidas por parte del Tesoro. Bessent afirmó que el presidente Donald Trump estaba manteniendo conversaciones telefónicas con líderes mundiales para pedirles específicamente que cesaran sus relaciones con Irán.

item.title: Trump bought shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, financial disclosure shows
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump invested as much as $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, according to a public financial disclosure, giving him a financial stake in a major government contractor run by his former adviser.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Rozen
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Donald Trump invested as much as $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O) in June, according to a public financial disclosure, giving him a financial stake in a major government contractor run by his former adviser. He bought between $15,001 and $50,000 in shares on June 23, according to a financial disclosure signed by him on August 12 and made public on August 22. The purchase was part of more than 1,000 stock trades the president made in June. SpaceX [USN:L6N42G18Z TEXT:"priced"] the biggest-ever U.S. IPO on June 12, valuing the space, satellite and AI provider at $1.77 trillion. In a statement to Reuters, White House spokesman Davis Ingle said that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio and replicate "recognized indexes, such as the Schwab 1000." "Neither President Trump nor any member of his family has any ability to direct, influence or provide input regarding how the portfolio is invested or when investments are bought or sold," Ingle said in the statement. Trump's investment in SpaceX adds a new financial link between the president and Musk's rocket company at a time when the administration is making decisions that could affect the firm's fortunes. SpaceX is a U.S. military [USN:L1N3P10ZT TEXT:"contractor,"] and often seeks [USN:L1N43U12L TEXT:"approvals"] from federal agencies. Trump on Thursday [USN:S0N3ZQ02C TEXT:"directed"] his team to help drastically increase the number of U.S. commercial space launches. SpaceX is a dominant player in that sector. U.S. Small Business Administration leader and Trump cabinet member Kelly Loeffler earned millions from SpaceX's IPO, Reuters previously [USN:L6N43H172 TEXT:"reported"]. Loeffler first invested in xAI, Musk’s AI and social media firm that has since [USN:L4N3YY1U7 TEXT:"merged"] with SpaceX. She invested again after Trump nominated her to lead the SBA. Her first investment in xAI would have been worth between $7 million and $2.6 billion on the day of the IPO, depending on the exact amount she invested and the date she made it, said Franco Granda, analyst at data provider PitchBook. The second investment would have been worth between $2.2 million and $25.4 million that day, he said. Reuters could not immediately determine the precise amount of Trump's investment because federal officials use ranges to declare the value of their assets on their financial disclosure forms.

item.title: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia killed in South Sudan ambush
item.description: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia were killed and seven other people injured in an ambush on Monday in South Sudan's Jonglei State, bringing to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in the line of duty worldwide this year, the United Nations said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Two U.N. peacekeepers from Ethiopia were killed and seven other people injured in an ambush on Monday in South Sudan's Jonglei State, bringing to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in the line of duty worldwide this year, the United Nations said. Among the injured were three U.N. peacekeepers, two police officers from South Sudan and two civilian staff members, U.N. spokesperson Stephane Dujarric told a press briefing. He said the attack was carried out by unidentified gunmen and the patrol appeared to have been deliberately targeted. "These are part of regular patrols that the U.N. has been doing in trying to help the constant insecurity in the area," Dujarric said. The U.N. has called on relevant authorities for a thorough and prompt investigation to ensure all those responsible are brought to justice, Dujarric said. He stressed that "attacks against U.N. peacekeepers may constitute war crimes under international law." The latest violence "brings to nine the number of peacekeepers killed in malicious acts since January 1 of this year," he added. Attacks on U.N. personnel are rare but not unprecedented in South Sudan, where U.N. patrols operate in volatile areas affected by intercommunal fighting, armed youth mobilizations and clashes involving government forces. In June, the U.N. Security Council adopted a resolution aimed at [USN:L1N42U11Y TEXT:"strengthening accountability for attacks on U.N. peacekeepers"], amid concern over rising violence and low prosecution rates. That followed a series of incidents targeting U.N. personnel, including the [USN:L1N42C0PN TEXT:"killing of seven peacekeepers serving with the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon"] after a fresh round of fighting broke out between Israel and Hezbollah in early March.

item.title: Alibaba lança modelo de vídeo com IA Wan3.0 após venda de ações de US$10 bilhões
item.description: A Alibaba lançou oficialmente nesta segunda-feira seu mais recente modelo de geração de vídeo com inteligência artificial, o Wan3.0, com recursos aprimorados, após a gigante chinesa da internet ter lançado uma emissão de ações no valor de US$10 bilhões para financiar os crescentes gastos com IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Alibaba (9988.HK) lançou oficialmente nesta segunda-feira seu mais recente modelo de geração de vídeo com inteligência artificial, o Wan3.0, com recursos aprimorados, após a gigante chinesa da internet ter lançado uma emissão de ações no valor de US$10 bilhões para financiar os crescentes gastos com IA. O novo modelo é capaz de gerar vídeos de 30 segundos a partir de documentos, planilhas, apresentações e páginas da web, informou a Alibaba Cloud em uma publicação na plataforma WeChat. A Alibaba informou que o Wan3.0 vem sendo utilizado na produção de curtas-metragens e filmes, em publicidade e marketing, na promoção turística e na criação de videoclipes desde que uma versão beta pública foi lançada em 6 de agosto. O lançamento ocorre um dia após o Alibaba ter anunciado a venda de ações, a maior oferta primária subsequente já realizada por uma empresa listada em Hong Kong, à medida que aumenta seus gastos na cada vez mais acirrada corrida global pela IA. Na semana passada, a Alibaba divulgou uma queda de 75% nos lucros trimestrais em relação ao ano anterior, devido ao aumento vertiginoso dos gastos de capital relacionados à IA. (Reportagem de Ethan Wang e Eduardo Baptista)

item.title: Italy regulator clears Ludoil's acquisition of Sicilian oil refiner
item.description: Italy's competition authority has cleared the acquisition of Sicily-based oil refiner ISAB by energy group Ludoil, the watchdog said on Monday, opening the way for a local company to control one fifth of the country's refining capacity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Italy's competition authority has cleared the [USN:L8N41Q1HU TEXT:"acquisition"] of Sicily-based oil refiner ISAB by energy group Ludoil, the watchdog said on Monday, opening the way for a local company to control one fifth of the country's refining capacity. Ludoil agreed in May to buy 51% of ISAB from Cypriot private equity fund G.O.I. Energy, subject to several conditions. The antitrust regulator said that the transaction would not hamper competition in the Italian market for refined products in a significant way, adding it would not open a full investigation on the acquisition. The refiner is linked to an exclusive long-term contract with global commodity trader Trafigura until 2033, the watchdog said in its document, revealing interesting details regarding its business. The supply and offtake agreement commits ISAB to sell approximately 90% of its refined petroleum products to Trafigura while Trafigura supplies ISAB with crude oil and the other raw materials required for refining, the competition authority said.

item.title: Israeli fire kills two young children in Gaza, medics say
item.description: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said. Medics and relatives said 10-year-old Amal Abu Khater was hit by a bullet in her back while she was eating inside her family's tent in the enclave's southern city of Khan Younis. The fire came from Israeli forces to the east, they added. The Israeli military said it was not aware of any incident involving a 10-year-old girl. A four-year-old boy and another Palestinian were killed in separate Israeli airstrikes on a house in Bureij refugee camp and a road in Khan Younis, medics said. Earlier on Monday, another Israeli airstrike killed one person and wounded another at a tent in Deir Al-Balah in the central Gaza Strip, medics said. The Israeli military said that strike in Deir Al-Balah targeted a Hamas militant, but did not specifically respond to questions about the other two reported attacks in Khan Younis and Bureij. More than 1,280 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since a ceasefire took effect last October , according to Gazan health officials, while the Israeli military says four Israeli soldiers have been killed. Hamas accuses Israel of violating the ceasefire and undermining efforts to implement a broader plan by U.S. President Donald Trump to end the Gaza conflict, which also includes Israeli withdrawals and Hamas disarmament. Israel says its strikes aimed to thwart imminent attacks by Hamas and other Gaza militants. The Israeli military issued two separate evacuation orders in Beach refugee camp and Deir Al-Balah in northern and central Gaza Strip before it carried out airstrikes in the two areas, without reports of casualties, residents and medics said. It also bombed a desalination plant in the Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood in Gaza City, at a time when the enclave is suffering water shortages, residents and Hamas said. An Israeli military spokesperson said the military had carried out strikes on several Hamas weapons storage sites throughout the day, including two inside mosques. The spokesperson said that among the sites targeted on Monday was one located adjacent to a desalination facility. The spokesperson said the military had not targeted the desalination facility and did not say whether or not it had been damaged in the strike.

item.title: Xiaomi lança novo chip Xring e faz parceria com TSMC para produção
item.description: A fabricante chinesa de smartphones Xiaomi divulgou nesta segunda-feira uma nova versão de seu microprocessador desenvolvido internamente, o Xring, apostando que um controle mais profundo sobre os principais componentes ajudará a fortalecer sua cadeia de suprimentos e a reduzir a dependência de fornecedores externos de chips.
item.dc:creator: Che Pan, Eduardo Baptista
item.content:encoded: A fabricante chinesa de smartphones Xiaomi (1810.HK) divulgou nesta segunda-feira uma nova versão de seu microprocessador desenvolvido internamente, o Xring, apostando que um controle mais profundo sobre os principais componentes ajudará a fortalecer sua cadeia de suprimentos e a reduzir a dependência de fornecedores externos de chips. O lançamento do Xring O3 ocorre um ano após a Xiaomi ter lançado seu primeiro processador próprio para smartphones, o Xring O1, marcando o mais recente passo da terceira maior fabricante mundial de smartphones em sua iniciativa de se juntar a rivais como Apple (AAPL.O) , Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) e Huawei no desenvolvimento de seus próprios chips. A TSMC (2330.TW) fabricará o novo chip da Xiaomi utilizando tecnologia de produção de 3 nanômetros, segundo duas fontes a par do assunto. Uma das fontes disse que o chip deve equipar o próximo smartphone dobrável da Xiaomi, com uma meta de entregas de 200 mil a 300 mil unidades. Representantes da Xiaomi e da TSMC não comentaram o assunto. Os processadores de smartphones, ou sistemas em chip (SoC), integram funções de computação, gráficos, processamento de IA e imagem em um único componente. A aposta da Xiaomi em chips reflete uma tendência mais ampla do setor, à medida que os fabricantes de dispositivos buscam diferenciar seus produtos e diminuir a dependência de fornecedores como Qualcomm (QCOM.O) e MediaTek (2454.TW) em meio à intensificação da concorrência no segmento de smartphones premium. A Xiaomi afirmou na semana passada que as vendas acumuladas de dispositivos equipados com o Xring O1 — incluindo smartphones, tablets e relógios — ultrapassaram 1 milhão de unidades desde seu lançamento. A Xiaomi vendeu cerca de 150 mil smartphones equipados com Xring O1 desde o lançamento, em maio de 2025, segundo as fontes.

item.title: France, Saudi Arabia agree on €6 billion Dragon Ball Z theme park project near Paris
item.description: France and Saudi Arabia have agreed to build a €6 billion ($7 billion) manga-themed amusement park near Paris, the Elysee Palace said on Monday during a visit by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the French capital.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France and Saudi Arabia have agreed to build a €6 billion ($7 billion) manga-themed amusement park near Paris, the Elysee Palace said on Monday during a visit by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to the French capital. The project, inspired by the world of the hit Japanese manga and anime franchise Dragon Ball Z, will be built near Cergy-Pontoise, northwest of Paris, and is expected to create around 22,000 jobs, the Elysee said. The idea was born after French President Emmanuel Macron and the Saudi crown prince discovered a shared enthusiasm for Dragon Ball Z during Macron’s visit to Saudi Arabia in 2025, Macron advisers said. Saudi entertainment and investment group Qiddiya will finance the project, which forms part of the kingdom’s push to [USN:L6N42B0X9 TEXT:"diversify its economy"] beyond oil and expand its global footprint in the leisure industry. No opening date has been set for what would be one of Europe’s largest theme park developments, with construction expected to take several years. Bin Salman, who owns a chateau near Paris, is making a rare official trip abroad and appeared alongside Macron at the closing ceremony of the Esports World Cup in Paris on Sunday. French officials cast the Dragon Ball Z project as evidence that France remains a magnet for foreign investment, though key details for the sprawling development that would include three different theme parks are yet to be settled. ($1 = 0.8571 euros)

item.title: UK, Ukraine sign AI defence partnership linked to battlefield technology
item.description: Britain said on Monday it had signed a partnership with Ukraine to jointly develop artificial intelligence tools for defence and security, giving British researchers access to a Ukrainian battlefield data platform used to train military AI systems.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain said on Monday it had signed a partnership with Ukraine to jointly develop artificial intelligence tools for defence and security, giving British researchers access to a Ukrainian battlefield data platform used to train military AI systems. Prime Minister Andy Burnham and President Volodymyr Zelenskiy signed the agreement in Kyiv, making Britain the first international partner to access Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs, a government statement said. Avengers Labs was built around an annotated dataset of 5 million battlefield images, Ukraine's Defence Ministry said earlier in August, largely drawn from the military's DELTA combat system – a domestically developed battlefield management and situational-awareness system. The platform uses data collected from cameras and sensors across Ukraine's battlefield, including information on tanks, artillery systems, drones and other military targets. The Ukrainian ministry said AI models trained on the data were already being used in an automated target-detection system that analyses more than 100,000 drone video feeds each month and can identify about 70% of enemy targets in real time. Under the deal, Britain and Ukraine will collaborate on pilot projects including technology that uses fibre-optic cables as AI-enabled sensors to help protect military facilities, and research into low-power AI chips for drones and autonomous systems. The British government said the partnership would initially focus on defence and national security projects bringing together researchers, engineers, technology companies and military experts from both countries. Burnham on Monday visited Ukraine for his first trip abroad since becoming prime minister, where he had talks with Zelenskiy and co-chaired a meeting of the "Coalition of the Willing." His office had earlier announced Britain would allow missile maker MBDA to [USN:L4N44K01O TEXT:"release classified information"] on British-made components used in the SCALP long-range cruise missile to help establish assembly lines in Ukraine.

item.title: ゼレンスキー氏、同盟国に防衛費不足270億ユーロの補填要請 防空支援強化も
item.description: [キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ　２４日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２４日、冬を前にロシアがエネルギー関連インフラへの攻撃を再び強化するとみられる中、同盟国に対して防空関連の支援パッケージを供与するよう要請した。キーウで開かれたウクライナを支援する「有志連合」の会合で述べた。

また、ゼレンスキー氏は２０２６年のウクライナの防衛部門に必要な資金の不足分２７０億ユーロを補うため、パートナー国に協力を求めた。

さらに、欧州各国の管轄下で凍結されているロシア資産について、同盟国に改めて言及し、凍結されたロシア資産を資金不足の一部補填に活用することを提案した。

item.title: Bancos defendem que Brasil faça lição de casa para enfrentar mundo mais complexo
item.description: A poucos meses das eleições no Brasil, presidentes de vários dos principais bancos do país defenderam nesta segunda-feira o equilíbrio das contas públicas e uma agenda para melhorar a produtividade, ressaltando um ambiente externo mais complexo.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: A poucos meses das eleições no Brasil, presidentes de vários dos principais bancos do país defenderam nesta segunda-feira o equilíbrio das contas públicas e uma agenda para melhorar a produtividade, ressaltando um ambiente externo mais complexo. "O que nós queremos ver efetivamente é equilíbrio fiscal, é um equilíbrio dessa dívida para que ela não suba nessa proporção em relação ao PIB", ressaltou o presidente-executivo do Bradesco , Marcelo Noronha, em painel durante evento de tecnologia no setor financeiro organizado pela federação de bancos, Febraban, em São Paulo. "É preciso haver vontade política para fazer isso", acrescentou o executivo. A dívida pública bruta do país como proporção do PIB fechou junho em 81,9%, contra 81,0% no mês anterior. Já a dívida líquida do setor público foi a 68,5%, de 67,9%. O Tesouro Nacional projeta que o indicador seguirá em alta até 2029. Desde que o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva assumiu o cargo, em janeiro de 2023, a dívida bruta do Brasil, considerada o principal indicador da solvência do país, [USN:L1N43X0M1 TEXT:"aumentou"] 10,2 pontos percentuais do PIB. O presidente-executivo do Itaú Unibanco , Milton Maluhy Filho, afirmou que é preciso olhar a questão do endividamento público. "A trajetória da dívida nesse ritmo é insustentável", afirmou, reforçando que o país deve parar de falar de superávit primário e déficit primário e falar de déficit nominal. "Com uma dívida de R$10 trilhões com juros a 14%, essa conta no longo prazo é muito complexa, não tem nenhuma economia que resista a um juro real no nível que estamos vivendo", afirmou. Maluhy Filho lembrou que os juros no nível atual prejudicam o principal negócio dos bancos, a concessão de crédito, uma vez que em cenários restritivos com o atual a inadimplência cresce e o setor é forçado a emprestar menos. O déficit nominal do Brasil subiu para quase 10% do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) nos 12 meses até junho, de acordo com dados divulgados no final de julho pelo Banco Central, atingindo o nível mais alto desde 2021 sob o impacto da conta de juros. O rombo aumentou para R$1,318 trilhão, o equivalente a 9,99% do PIB, ante 9,61% até maio e 7,27% um ano antes. Na próxima semana, uma atualização dos números vai ser divulgada pelo Banco Central. O presidente-executivo do Santander Brasil , Gilson Finkelsztain, reforçou o discurso afirmando que o Brasil precisa se ajustar rápido porque o cenário global vai ser mais difícil, em meio a uma "competição por capital" em que outras economias também estão elevando os juros. "Toda esta agenda local precisa ter o dobro de esforço para botar ordem na casa porque o mundo está mais complexo", afirmou. O presidente-executivo do BTG Pactual , Roberto Sallouti, chamou atenção para questões como custo de capital, governança fiscal e produtividade. "Nós não podemos contar com o crescimento populacional para aumentar o nosso próprio potencial. Nós temos que ganhar produtividade. Educação, uso de tecnologia, infraestrutura e assim por diante", afirmou, destacando a inteligência artificial. "Nós estamos vivendo uma revolução tecnológica, que primeiro está levando um capex (investimento) enorme que está pressionando os mercados, e depois vai gerar ganhos de produtividade inimagináveis", disse Sallouti.

item.title: GRANOS Maíz alcanza máximo en tres años en Chicago, operadores prevén una menor producción en EEUU
item.description: Los futuros del maíz de Chicago se dispararon el lunes hasta alcanzar máximos de tres años, después de que una visita a la zona productora de maíz y soja de Estados Unidos la semana pasada revelara que la cosecha del cereal se encontraba en peores condiciones de lo que muchos esperaban.
item.dc:creator: Heather Schlitz
item.content:encoded: Los futuros del maíz de Chicago se dispararon el lunes hasta alcanzar máximos de tres años, después de que una visita a la zona productora de maíz y soja de Estados Unidos la semana pasada revelara que la cosecha del cereal se encontraba en peores condiciones de lo que muchos esperaban. El trigo alcanzó su nivel más alto en unos dos años, ya que los ataques recíprocos entre Rusia y Ucrania limitaron las exportaciones desde los puertos del Mar Negro. La soja bajó, presionada por la caída del precio del petróleo, pero las pérdidas se vieron limitadas por la fuerte demanda de exportación de soja estadounidense. El contrato de maíz más activo de la Bolsa de Chicago sumaba 10,25 centavos a 5,1875 dólares por bushel a las 1530 GMT, tras alcanzar los 5,2525 dólares por bushel, su nivel más alto desde 2023. La mayoría de los contratos de maíz registraron máximos históricos. "El mercado repuntó durante la noche tras los datos del viernes publicados al cierre de la sesión", afirmó Joe Davis, director de ventas de materias primas de Futures International. El servicio de asesoramiento Pro Farmer estimó el viernes que la producción de maíz de Estados Unidos en 2026 se situará muy por debajo de las previsiones del Gobierno, después de que una gira por siete de los principales estados productores revelara que las cosechas, por debajo de lo habitual, se han visto perjudicadas por las condiciones meteorológicas adversas del verano. Pro Farmer prevé que los agricultores cosechen 15.344 millones de bushels de maíz, un 9,9% menos que en 2025, pero aún así la tercera cosecha más grande de la historia, con un rendimiento medio de 173,2 bushels por acre. La estimación de rendimiento de Pro Farmer para Estados Unidos, de concretarse, sería la más baja desde 2020. "La gente se quedó sorprendida al ver esa cifra", dijo Davis. Los operadores también temen que el fenómeno meteorológico de El Niño reduzca la producción de maíz en Brasil y están preocupados por la capacidad de Ucrania para exportar, según los analistas. En cuanto a otros cultivos, el trigo de la CBOT subió 4 centavos a 7,03 dólares el bushel tras alcanzar su máximo en aproximadamente dos años. La soja cayó 18 centavos a 12,2150 dólares el bushel. El trigo se vio sometido a presión el lunes después de que el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, afirmara que se seguiría una "vía diplomática" con Rusia para debatir la intensificación de los ataques de Moscú en el mar Negro. Las exportaciones de trigo del mar Negro se han visto gravemente reducidas debido a la escalada de ataques en la región. "Hoy no hay un bloqueo total, pero se está intentando establecerlo. No obstante, entre tres y cuatro barcos al día entran y salen del área metropolitana de Odesa", afirmó Zelenski. La debilidad de los precios del aceite de soja lastró al complejo de la soja el lunes. El aceite de soja cayó debido al efecto de contagio de la debilidad del petróleo, que bajó más de 1 dólar por barril, ya que los inversionistas recogieron beneficios tras las recientes alzas.

item.title: Report: Patriots sign P Matt Haack
item.description: The Patriots signed veteran punter Matt Haack on Monday, according to ESPN.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Patriots signed veteran punter Matt Haack on Monday, according to ESPN. New England coach Mike Vrabel told reporters that the team would be adding a new punter after Bryce Baringer was forced to exit Saturday's preseason win over the Philadelphia Eagles with an injury. Haack, 32, was most recently with the Washington Commanders this offseason as a temporary injury replacement for Tress Way before he was released last week. He saw action last season, his ninth in the NFL, for the Arizona Cardinals, punting 25 times over seven games and averaging 51.3 yards per punt and 43.4 net yards per punt. Haack appeared in 12 games over the last three seasons after serving as a full-time starter for his first six NFL seasons. He has career averages of 45.0 yards per punt and 39.9 net yards per punt over 478 punts across 110 games for the Miami Dolphins (2017-20), Buffalo Bills (2021), Indianapolis Colts (2022), Cleveland Browns (2023), New York Giants (2024) and Cardinals. --Field Level Media

Aug 24 : Iraq's Australian coach Graham Arnold has renewed his contract with the team until 2027, the country's FA said on Monday. After weeks of speculation, the IFA made the announcement at a press conference attended by the 63-year-old, confirming he would remain in charge through the Gulf Cup in Saudi Arabia in September, as well as the Asian Cup early next year. "I have renewed my contract for six months and this decision is in my best interest and in the best interest of the Iraq national team, although the association offered me a four-year extension," Arnold was quoted as saying by the Iraqi News Agency. Arnold guided Iraq to this year's World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico, ending a 40-year absence from the tournament. However, Iraq exited at the group stage after losing all of their Group I matches against Norway, France and Senegal.

item.title: 中国国家主席、7年ぶりインド訪問へ ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議に大規模代表団
item.description:
Saurabh Sharma Aftab Ahmed
[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Saurabh Sharma　Aftab Ahmed

[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席が、９月にインドで開催される新興国グループ「ＢＲＩＣＳ」首脳会議に大規模な代表団を率いて出席する見通しだと、関係者３人が明らかにした。実現すれば７年ぶりの訪問となり、中国とインドの関係改善につながる可能性がある。

ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議は９月１２、１３両日にニューデリーで開催。２０２０年の両国国境付近での衝突を受けて悪化した関係の修復につながるかどうかが注目される。トランプ米政権の通商政策を踏まえ、ＢＲＩＣＳ諸国の経済への悪影響を抑えたい意向とみられる。

インド関係者の１人はロイターに「中国当局者は、宿泊や警備体制の最終調整をしている」と述べた。関係者２人によると、約４００人の中国当局者が同行する見通し。１９年の前回訪問時は２００人未満だった。

関係者らによると、両国の当局者らは首脳による協議で、国境や地域の安全保障問題を巡る長年の対立を調整しつつ、関係拡大へ向けた方法を模索するとみられる。習氏の最終的な訪問計画や二国間会談に関する議題などは未確定という。

インドのモディ首相は昨年、７年ぶりに中国を訪問したものの、両国関係に大きな改善は見られていない。インドのアジト・ドバル国家安全保障顧問は２４日から訪中し、王毅外相と国境問題に関して協議する見通しだ。

中国外務省は「今年のＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議が成功するよう支援する」とした上で、習氏の訪問に関して「現時点で提供できる情報はない」と述べた。２５年にブラジルで開かれた前回のＢＲＩＣＳサミットでは、習氏は出席を見送っていた。

item.title: China's Xi likely to visit India with big delegation for first time in seven years

China's Xi likely to visit India with big delegation for first time in seven years

India-China relations have remained strained for years, largely due to ongoing border tensions and territorial disputes.

Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi meet on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in Kazan, Russia, on Oct 23, 2024. (Photo: REUTERS/China Daily)

FAST

NEW DELHI: Chinese President Xi Jinping is likely to attend next month's BRICS summit in New Delhi with a large delegation , three sources said, in what would be his first visit in seven years and a fresh sign of a thaw between the rivals. India is hosting the Sep 12 to 13 summit, where Xi 's presence would be watched less for the BRICS agenda than for what it signals about Beijing and New Delhi's efforts to stabilise relations after deadly border clashes in 2020 . "Chinese officials are busy finalising hotels and security protocols," one of the India n sources with direct knowledge told Reuters. Last year, India n Prime Minister Narendra Modi visit ed China for the first time in seven years , but the relationship has only improved gradually. More recently, a fresh border-related dispute triggered sharp diplomatic exchanges between the two sides.

Two other India n sources said Xi was likely to be accompanied by a delegation of about 400 officials, compared with fewer than 200 officials the last time in 2019. Officials from both countries are expected to use the summit to explore ways to expand engagement while managing long-standing differences over the border and regional security issues, the sources added. Xi 's final travel plans and agenda for any potential bilateral between India and China are yet to be finalised , the sources said. The Chinese foreign ministry said, "China attaches great importance to and actively participates in BRICS cooperation, and supports India , the current chair, in successfully hosting this year's BRICS summit." "We currently have no information available to provide" about Xi 's visit , it said. Xi missed the last BRICS summit in 2025 in Brazil. India 's foreign ministry did not comment.

INDIA -CHINA BORDER ISSUE The world's two most populous nations, both nuclear powers, share a roughly 3,800-km (2,400-mile), largely undemarcated and disputed border in the Himalayas. Decades of relative peace along the border were shattered by 2020 clashes where 20 India n and four Chinese soldiers were killed. The incident led to a four-year military standoff before reaching a disengagement pact in October 2024. But on Aug 12, India said peace along the border was critical to ties after reports that India n and Chinese army patrols came face-to-face in late July near a remote border. India 's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval on Monday (Aug 24) started his visit to Beijing to meet Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi to hold talks on the boundary issue. While India and China remain competitors, US President Donald Trump's trade policies have created one area of convergence, making Xi 's attendance a signal that neither side wants external pressure to undermine BRICS.

FAST

JOHANNESBURG, Aug 24 : South Africa coach Rassie Erasmus wants his team to turn the hurt of their weekend defeat by New Zealand into fuel to get themselves back into contention in the four-test series. The Springboks lost their top world ranking when New Zealand won the opening test 33-16 at Ellis Park on Saturday, outscoring their hosts five tries to one as they saw off South Africa’s efforts to muscle them into submission. The world champions had been favourites before the start of the first test of the Kiwis’ eight-match tour. "One could see the hurt on everyone’s faces after Saturday’s match, and we know what we have to do to bounce back strongly this week," Erasmus said as he announced the line-up for the second test in Cape Town on Saturday.

"There were a handful of positives and negatives last week, but the main thing that let us down was that we created so many chances, but mistakes at crucial times cost us," Erasmus told reporters on Monday. "We are angry with each other. The coaches did and said stupid things. The players did stupid things on the pitch," added Erasmus. "Me personally, I made wrong calls on some of the tactics we wanted to try and do inside their 22. It didn’t work and that’s on me." Erasmus went back to naming his side early, but kept the All Blacks guessing by putting flanker Siya Kolisi back in the side if the inspirational captain proves his fitness. If not, Paul de Villiers will stay in the starting line-up. "Paul played well on Saturday, and there’s no reason why we should keep him out, but Siya is our captain," the coach said. "Siya has got some strengths, one of them being the attacking breakdown, he’s really good at sorting that out for us, which was the area we struggled with. "There were lots of times that we played badly, not because they did anything illegal, but we couldn’t get the ball away out of the breakdown when we were in really good attacking positions. Siya’s really good at that," Erasmus added.

item.title: Gang attack on hillside town near Haiti's capital leaves 30 dead
item.description: At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday. Kenscoff is a hillside town overlooking Port-au-Prince has seen frequent gang attacks over the last couple of years. Rights groups have reported mass killings, rapes, arson and kidnappings, forcing thousands to flee their homes. Haitian rights group RNDDH estimated 30 to 40 people had been killed and 15 to 20 wounded in the overnight raid, which began around 10:30 p.m. local time (0230 GMT), but warned it was still difficult to assess a complete tally. Haiti's prime minister's office on Monday afternoon decried the "heinous attack", noting all security forces were on high alert and reinforcements were being deployed. "Kenscoff will not be abandoned," it said in a statement. "The government's authority will be restored, without weakness and without delay, throughout all of Kenscoff." Haiti's national police did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The community occupies a strategic position overlooking routes into Petion-Ville - home to several embassies, upscale hotels and the temporary seat of government - as well as routes from the capital into southern parts of the country. Local media said several houses were set on fire, including the home of Jean William Pape, a leading public health expert in Haiti. The attack occurred as the U.N.-backed Gang Suppression Force, which is mandated to help police fight gangs and replace an underfunded and ineffectual predecessor, plans to reach a full capacity of more than 5,500 troops by fall this year.

item.title: 49ers owner Jed York pleads no contest after arrest in Ohio
item.description: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to reduced charges in Ohio on Monday after reaching an agreement with prosecutors following his Sunday arrest on suspicion of engaging in prostitution.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York pleaded no contest to reduced charges in Ohio on Monday after reaching an agreement with prosecutors following his Sunday arrest on suspicion of engaging in prostitution. In a plea deal entered Monday, prosecutors amended the original charge to misdemeanor disorderly conduct and possessing criminal tools. According to reports, the criminal tool in York's possession was believed to be a cell phone used to reply to a prostitution advertisement. York, 46, was arrested in East Palestine. Court documents indicate agents for the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force intercepted communication in which York responded to a prostitution website. York, like other NFL owners, is subject to the league's personal conduct policy. The NFL had not commented on the matter as of Monday afternoon. As part of the reduced charges, York was sentenced to one day in the Columbiana County Jail for each count. He was credited with time served Sunday and paid a fine of $1,150, according to court records. York, a native of Youngstown, Ohio, has been CEO of the 49ers since December 2008 and the team's principal owner since 2024. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mark Carney sensibly avoids stepping in fertilizer
item.description: Canada's prime minister rejected the latest US trade proposal, prompting fresh tariff talk. Ontario also wants exports like potash and oil cut off, which would seriously escalate the clash. Waiting out President Trump while pursuing more deals in Asia and beyond is better policy.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Rubin
item.content:encoded: The United States and its neighbor to the north will share the longest land-border in the world even after President Donald Trump leaves office in 2029. It's an immutable restraint on Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's leverage in a [USN:L1N44J034 TEXT:"trade war"], but also a lasting benefit. After rejecting the latest U.S. proposal, plodding patience is shrewder than extreme pressure. The White House, naturally, responded to the weekend's breakdown in negotiations with 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. Carney, who called U.S. demands "uneconomic" and "unfair" vowed to return the favor "dollar for dollar," prompting Trump to threaten to extend 50% tariffs onto all of the country's inbound cars, trucks and automotive parts. In Carney's interpretation, Trump wants to restrict Canada's ability to trade with other countries and unspecified demands related to Canadian culture, language and sovereignty. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Canada may have rejected the deal “perhaps for political reasons.” Canada has a nuclear option, one that leaders in Ontario and other provinces are ready to trigger. They want to cut off U.S. access to fertilizer and energy from the Great White North. About 85% of U.S. potash, essential in farming, comes from Canada, as does about 4 million barrels of oil daily, 60% of U.S. imports. Doing so would make it clearer that dependencies go both ways and heap additional economic pressure on Trump. The risks are greater than the rewards, however. Commodities, in particular, depend on supplier reliability. Once new providers are found, the business doesn’t tend to come back. U.S. [USN:L6N3WB0VG TEXT:"soybeans"] are instructive. Once they became leverage in the trade war with China, purchase agreements for U.S. farmers dried up. Even after a truce was struck, Beijing agreed to buy just 12 million metric tons from the United States last year, less than half as many as in 2024. Slow and steady is the better approach. Carney has good reasons to snub any limitations on Canada’s ability to trade unfettered with other countries. His top job is to dilute the 70% U.S. share of exports, as he has been doing with energy in India, China, and the EU. Carney's popularity at home affords him time and political capital, while Trump's mid-30s approval rating as midterm elections approach boosts the chances for U.S. policy revisions. There's no reason to step in fertilizer. Follow Gabriel Rubin on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on August 22 rejected a U.S. trade proposal, saying it was "a bad deal." U.S. President Donald Trump responded by imposing 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods, with Carney vowing to retaliate "dollar for dollar." Trump subsequently warned on August 24 that U.S. tariffs on all Canadian cars, trucks and automotive parts would be increased to 50% starting on January 1. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Japan eyes tax breaks for non-core business sales in governance reform push, sources say
item.description: Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Makiko Yamazaki, Miho Uranaka
item.content:encoded: Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said. The plan would remove a major obstacle to companies shedding non-core businesses and redeploying capital into growth areas, in what could become one of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's most significant initiatives to advance corporate governance reform. Under the plan, roughly 30% corporate tax on gains from sales of non-core businesses would be deferred indefinitely, provided companies reinvest the proceeds within several years in acquisitions aligned with their core operations and commit to investing in those businesses, one of the sources said. The proposal is expected to be submitted as part of tax reform requests due at the end of this month, with details to be worked out before a final tax reform package for the next fiscal year is approved at year-end, said one of the sources, who declined to be identified as the matter is still private. POOR CAPITAL ALLOCATION The initiative is modelled on Germany's tax reform in the early 2000s, which largely exempted corporations from taxes on gains from share disposals, helping dismantle the country's dense network of cross-shareholdings and making it easier for companies to reshape their business portfolios. Non-core businesses often remain trapped within sprawling Japanese conglomerates because gains from divestitures are taxed, reducing the incentive to transfer assets to owners better positioned to extract value from them. The result is often inefficient capital allocation. A recent government study found that about 65% of Japanese companies' invested capital remains tied up in businesses that fail to earn their cost of capital, largely offsetting value created by higher-performing units. Such capital trapped in low-return operations is seen as limiting growth investment and weighing on long-term corporate value. Japan has already introduced a range of measures to promote business overhauls over the years, including spin-off tax rules in 2017 and a partial spin-off regime in 2023, but business divestitures taking advantage of those rules have remained relatively limited. A 2020 industry ministry report showed Japanese companies often lack clear divestment criteria and have traditionally prioritised maintaining group size, employment and corporate stability over portfolio reshaping. The tax reform, if implemented, is likely to boost already sizzling M&A activity in Japan. Deal activity involving Japanese companies last year more than doubled from the previous year to a record $353 billion, according to LSEG. Divestitures of Japanese businesses accounted for $44.7 billion of that total.

Aug 24 : A torrential hailstorm in the French Pyrenees forced the abandonment of the third stage of the Vuelta a Espana on Monday. With 15 km (9.32 miles) remaining of the 174-km route from Gruissan to Font-Romeu, the skies darkened as the peloton neared the top of the Col de Mont-Louis and huge hailstones began bouncing off the tarmac and pelting the riders. Mats Wenzel (Kern Pharma) and Lorenzo Fortunato (XDS Astana) were 25 seconds ahead of the peloton when the elements intervened as race leader and favourite Tadej Pogacar was seen indicating to the peloton to pull off the course. Bedraggled riders were then seen getting off their bikes and shuffling into a hotel for shelter.

Shortly afterwards race organisers ASO announced the stage would not resume, leaving fans frustrated at the finish where thick layers of hail blanketed the road. Slovenia's Pogacar (UAE Emirates-XRG) retained his overall lead of nine seconds from Belgium's Wout van Aert (Dutch Visma-Lease a Bike) with Britain's Matt Brennan 10 seconds back. Earlier it had been warm and sunny on the flat approaches to the mountainous finish with no sign of the chaos to come as a five-man breakaway group stayed out ahead. Pogacar, bidding to complete his Grand Tour collection by winning the Vuelta for the first time, was always near the front of the pack with his team setting the pace. Sadly, his expected challenge for the stage victory fell foul of the weather in an anti-climactic finish. He will get his chance to underline his superiority again on Tuesday though with stage four featuring three first-category climbs as the race starts and finishes in Andorra la Vella.

item.title: 米トランプ政権、専門職ビザ手数料10万ドル超へ 規制案公表
item.description:
Daniel Wiessner
[２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Daniel Wiessner

[２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は２４日、専門技能を持つ外国人労働者向け就労ビザ「Ｈ－１Ｂ」の申請手数料を約１０万ドルとする措置を法制化するための規制案を公表した。

トランプ大統領は昨年９月、移民取り締まり強化の一環として、同ビザの手数料引き上げに向けた大統領布告に署名。従来の手数料である約２０００─５０００ドルから１０万ドル超へと大幅に引き上げる内容。

ただ、連邦地裁は６月、議会の承認を得ていない違法な課税に当たるとして、無効とする判断を示し、その後控訴審での審理が続いている。

布告は９月に失効するものの、国土安全保障省に手数料増額を恒久化するための規則を制定するよう指示していた。

同省がオンライン官報に掲載した規制案によると、手数料は１０万３２６５ドルに引き上げられ、２５日に正式に公表される。その後、３０日間のパブリックコメント期間を経て、年末までに最終決定される可能性がある。

item.title: Browns to open season with Deshaun Watson as QB1
item.description: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season. "Took in the full body of work over the course of offseason to training camp to the games and the joint practice, and ultimately, felt like to start the season on the road, Deshaun gave us the best chance to move the ball and score points," Monken said Monday. "And that's really what it's about. I felt that way going into the last game, but wasn't sure. And after we talked as a staff and after we re-looked at everything, we're going to let it rip." Watson and Shedeur Sanders competed for the starting job in training camp, rotating reps with the first-team offense in practice and preseason games. The Browns begin the 2026 regular season with two road games: Sept. 13 at the Jacksonville Jaguars and the following week at Tampa Bay. Cleveland's first home game is Sept. 27 against the Carolina Panthers. Despite reports the Browns were considering holding Sanders in the backup role until the home opener, Monken said Monday he's not entering into a "week-to-week thing" and expects Watson to excel. "Again, I think Shedeur has done a great job, come a long ways, and we're excited about his future. But this is not a week-to-week decision," he said. Cleveland covets stability at the position, and Watson was viewed as the potential answer when he was acquired from the Houston Texans prior to the 2022 season. As part of the trade, Watson signed a five-year, $230 million contract. But after starting his tenure with the team serving a suspension, he has been hindered by injuries and is just 9-10 as a starter in Cleveland. He hasn't played more than seven games in any of his four seasons with the Browns. Watson did not play last season while recovering from two surgeries to repair his Achilles. Watson tore his right Achilles tendon in October 2024 and a recurrence of the same injury during rehab prompted a second operation. Sanders, a fifth-round pick in 2025, was thrown into the lineup as a rookie. With Watson on injured reserve all season, the Browns began the season with Joe Flacco as the starter but traded him to the Cincinnati Bengals. Dillon Gabriel, a third-round rookie in 2025, was named the starter but Sanders took over in November. He had seven touchdown passes and 10 interceptions in eight games. Watson likely needs a strong start to the regular season to win back a fan base that appears to be running out of patience. Watson was showered with boos by home fans during Saturday's preseason game and said it was "personal." He played the second half against Buffalo and completed 5 of 12 passes for 36 yards and an interception "It's a little bit (more) personal than that. So I think it's a disrespectful thing," Watson said of being booed at home. "So yeah, I mean, I'm going to keep whatever I feel with me and my family internally on how I feel about that. And yeah, just move on." Watson, who turns 31 the day after the Week 1 opener, used time with the media Monday to walk back some of his views on Browns fans. "... I think my emotions got the best of me," Watson said. "My comments wasn't intended to go at any of the fans around the city, because there's been a lot of great fans that have been supporting me." Monken, hired to replace Kevin Stefanski, is a first-time head coach after serving as the Baltimore Ravens' offensive coordinator for the last three seasons. He said Watson and the Browns can avoid being booed at home by playing better, but also offered his perspective on Watson's response. "I see the competitor in him. I see the everyday work he puts in, and he wants to be back," Monken said. "He wants to get back to where he was as best he can, and that's hard. And again, I think the moment just got him after the game, and it can get all of us." --Field Level Media

FAST

LONDON, Aug 24 : England fast bowler Brydon Carse has been dropped from the squad for the second test against Pakistan following an investigation into an incident at a club in Derby, the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) said on Monday. "Following a referral from the ECB, the Cricket Regulator has confirmed that they will investigate events on Saturday night in Derby," the ECB said in a statement. "Brydon Carse will no longer be available for selection for the second men's test while this investigation is ongoing and the full facts are obtained." Carse, who did not play in the opening test victory at Headingley, will be replaced by Sonny Baker.

Videos circulated on social media appearing to show the 31-year-old Durham bowler in handcuffs being spoken to by police officers outside a venue. According to reports, Carse was not arrested and no charges were brought. It has been a busy summer for England's Cricket Regulator, the body set up to investigate matters where there is an allegation of a breach of the ECB's code of conduct. In June it concluded an investigation into former test captain Ben Stokes and fast bowler Gus Atkinson after a nightclub incident following the first test against New Zealand. Both were left out of the second test before the Regulator ruled that there was insufficient evidence to establish that any regulatory breach occurred. The latest investigation comes five days after England's returning test captain Joe Root spoke of the players being "really good role models and human beings" following a series of incidents and accusations of a drinking culture. Controversy has followed England around in recent times with off-field issues during last winter’s tours, including Harry Brook being fined £30,000 ($41,000) following an altercation in Wellington as well as reports of drinking during a mid-Ashes series trip to Noosa. Stokes retired from international cricket after returning for the third test against New Zealand and Brendon McCullum was sacked as test coach.

item.title: フーシ派、サウジのヤンブー沖で船舶攻撃と発表 国営海運バハリも被弾確認
item.description: [カイロ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カイロ　２４日　ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２４日、サウジアラビアの紅海沿岸にあるヤンブー港沖で船舶を攻撃したと発表した。同派の軍事報道官ヤヒヤ・サリー氏がテレビ演説で明らかにした。

サウジアラビアの国営海運会社バハリも同日、自社の船舶「アムザン」が紅海で攻撃を受けたと声明で明らかにした。

これに先立ち、英海事貿易機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は、ヤンブーの西方６３カイリの海域でタンカーが正体不明の飛翔体による攻撃を受けたと発表。ＵＫＭＴＯによると、乗組員全員の安全が確認されており、環境への影響も報告されていないという。

ヤンブーはサウジの主要な紅海沿岸の石油積み出し港で、１日あたり数百万バレルの石油が積み出されている。また、イランが封鎖しているホルムズ海峡を迂回するサウジ産原油の主要な輸出ルートとなっている。

item.title: Former world champion Dott convicted of historical sexual abuse
item.description: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court. Dott was charged with two counts of "lewd, indecent and libidinous behaviour", against a girl between 1993 and 1996, and a boy between 2006 and 2010. The indictment alleged that the 49-year-old had sexually assaulted the girl, exposed himself to her and induced her to touch him. Dott was also accused of making sexual remarks to the boy and touching his genitals. He denied the charges but was found guilty after a trial at the High Court in Glasgow. He will be sentenced next month. "Dott is a dangerous individual and I hope this conviction provides some measure of comfort to those impacted by his crimes," Detective Inspector Gary Smillie from Police Scotland told reporters. Dott won the world snooker championship in 2006, beating Peter Ebdon 18-14 in the final, and twice finished as runner-up in 2004 and 2010. He was suspended by the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association after the charges were announced last year.

FAST

JOHANNESBURG, Aug 24 : New Zealand flyhalf Richie Mo'unga will don an All Blacks jersey on Tuesday for the first time since the last World Cup final as he makes a bid for a place in the squad for next year’s global tournament. Mo'unga will start against the Lions at Ellis Park as New Zealand play the last game against provincial opposition on their eight-match tour of South Africa. The 32-year-old was called up as an injury replacement in an effort by new coach Dave Rennie to integrate him into the squad one year out from the 2027 World Cup in Australia. "One reason for coming back was obviously to win a World Cup, but to not have any regrets of ‘geez, I wish I had given it another crack or maybe there was a bit more to give," Mo’unga told reporters on Monday.

"I’ve just come back really grateful. I knew I missed it, but coming back in, you realise this is a really special circle to be in. I’m just really savouring every moment and just not going to take these things for granted," he added. The All Blacks have Ruben Love as first-choice flyhalf and unless there is an injury or major loss of form, there is little chance Mo'unga will play in the remaining three tests. Mo’unga was unavailable for selection after three seasons with Toshiba Brave Lupus in Japan because the All Blacks have rules on only picking home-based players, but he returned to New Zealand in June and was included in an All Blacks training camp. His first opportunity to play for Canterbury came after the tour party had departed for South Africa, but injury to Billy Proctor gave Rennie the chance to call up the skilful Mo’unga as a replacement New Zealand lost the last World Cup final in Paris in 2023 by one point to South Africa but blitzed the Springboks 33-16 at Ellis Park on Saturday in the first of the four-test series dubbed "Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry".
